A flow-inserted stage on those would add a cycle to every priced static-join edge age (die_ages.json / kv_static_ages) that the compiled calendar does not have.  Waived (depth <= 3 or fault-only): pc__ki (hck kick word, depth 3: a stage would move the priced kick age), x__est__0_1 (emb boot-ready level, depth 1), pc__fi (fault-chain sticky OR, 1 sink, fault-only; 0.8 T hck budget).
